description: This header file defines the NotificationHandler class responsible for managing notifications in the host interface component. It declares methods for pushing various notification types, singleton access, callback registration, and notification queue retrieval. It also includes external headers and function pointer typedefs.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: A singleton class that manages notification handling, providing interfaces to push notifications, register callbacks, and access the notification queue.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NotificationHandler.

methods.name: GetNotificationQueue
methods.description: Provides access to the notification queue used for asynchronous notification processing.

methods.name: registerUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be invoked upon notification updates.

methods.name: pushValueChangeNotification
methods.description: Pushes a value change event notification based on the provided event data.

methods.name: pushKeyValueNotification
methods.description: Pushes a key-value notification to a specified destination.

methods.name: push_device_mgmt_notifications
methods.description: Sends device management related notifications with various status parameters.

methods.name: push_device_deepsleep_notifications
methods.description: Pushes deepsleep status notifications with event time information.
